_source: 审计修复：FAIL-4 叙事逻辑残留无量化黑名单
_usage: MODEL_B（审计角色）在 skill-2 中英对照 + skill-5 A21 自检时，扫描英文脚本里的中国史观残留词

_threshold.扫描范围: 所有英文正文（不含标题/简介）

_note: 以下是**英文翻译中可能不自觉带出中国史观的词汇/句型**。扫描时做大小写不敏感匹配 + 上下文判断（如果 context 是在解构/批判这个框架，不算残留）

entries.framework: 道德史观（明君/昏君/暴君）
entries.safe_context_example: was labeled a tyrant by later historians, let's look at what documents actually say
entries.unsafe_example: he was a great emperor who brought prosperity to the land

entries.safe_context_example: the fact that he won shaped how historians framed his actions
entries.unsafe_example: because he won, he was right

entries.safe_context_example: contemporary propaganda framed his rise as a heavenly mandate
entries.unsafe_example: his victory was destined by heaven

entries.safe_context_example: the system rewarded officials who demonstrated loyalty to the throne
entries.unsafe_example: he was a loyal servant while the other was a traitor

entries.safe_context_example: unification simplified trade routes but also redistributed tax burdens onto local populations
entries.unsafe_example: unification was the right and inevitable outcome

entries.safe_context_example: contemporary texts referred to them as barbarians; let's look at what archaeological evidence shows about their society
entries.unsafe_example: they were uncivilized compared to the Chinese

blacklist_en: all dynasties end the same way
historical pattern of rise and collapse
entries.safe_context_example: multiple factors—fiscal collapse, military mutiny, and succession crisis—intersected at this point
entries.unsafe_example: this dynasty followed the inevitable pattern of rise and fall

blacklist_en: the man who made it all happen
entries.safe_context_example: his decisions interacted with a broader fiscal crisis and military vacuum
entries.unsafe_example: he single-handedly changed the course of Chinese history

blacklist_en: the real story they covered up
entries.safe_context_example: the official annals only recorded his death, not what happened to his allies—this is a gap we need to acknowledge
entries.unsafe_example: history has been hiding the truth from you

blacklist_en: his past actions caught up with him
entries.safe_context_example: after years of fiscal strain and military overextension, his regime collapsed
entries.unsafe_example: in the end, his past cruelty caught up with him

scan_instructions: 1. MODEL_B 扫描英文脚本的 blacklist_en 词汇。2. 每个匹配检查上下文，如果 safe_context 句型出现则降级。3. 每 1000 词累计 ≥ 2 次 → FAIL；= 1 次 → WARN（人类判断）。4. Gate 3 报告里标注：哪个词、哪段、原文、为什么算残留、建议改法。
